description: Round-2 fixup, Phase 4 — post-break anchor: spanning Normal-mode Loop clip resumes from where the user was watching at GO, not from the natural clipStart-derived mapping. 30fps timeline, single Loop clip on track 0 starting at frame 0, duration 240. Source asset gradient_seq has 16 frames so Loop wraps modulo 16. The natural (phase-discarding) mapping at any playhead P is P % 16; the anchor mapping is (anchor + delta) % 16 where anchor reflects the actual source frame the user saw at GO — with the at-break park advancing phase well past the natural value. The two assertions: (a) post-GO the playhead advances past the break and state is Playing — proves SectionGo did its job end-to-end; (b) the mapped mediaFrame differs from the natural mapping computed at the same instant (mode=notNatural) — proves the anchor branch is steering. Detailed anchor math (Loop/PingPong wrap correctness, multi-break re-seed, scrub reset) is covered by tests/unit/PostBreakAnchorTests.cpp; this script is the end-to-end smoke that wires Director's GO state machine into the per-tick mapping. CI-robustness notes: WaitUntil replaces fixed WaitSeconds/WaitFrames-then-assert (the old form hard-coded natural=14, only valid if the assert sampled at exactly playhead 62; slow WARP runners sampled at 69 where the hard-coded value asserts nothing). notNatural is evaluated against the live playhead, so it is valid at any sampling moment.
